channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump vows to find ‘leakers’ after reports of depleted Iran war munitions
item.description: The Trump administration has repeatedly pushed back on reports of shortages of both US offensive and defensive weapons.

item.title: UNICEF says one child killed per day in Gaza since ‘ceasefire’
item.description: At least 300 children reported killed in Gaza in 300 days since October 2025 truce between Israel and Hamas was agreed.

item.title: War on Iran: Iran and Oman agree on Strait of Hormuz deal
item.description: Iran and Oman agree on new coordinates for ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Rights groups call Israel’s killing of journalist Amal Khalil a ‘war crime’
item.description: Human Rights Watch, Amnesty say Israel seemingly targeted and killed the Lebanese journalist, obstructed rescuers.

item.title: Houthi attacks on Yemeni government forces kill at least 30
item.description: Attacks are deadliest in Yemen's conflict between Houthis and government forces in years.

item.title: Iran tightens security grip at home as war conditions with US linger
item.description: Executions, arrests and closure of public gathering spaces have raised concerns among Iranians and rights groups.

item.title: Will the US-Iran war and Hormuz deadlock last for months?
item.description: Will the war on Iran and Hormuz deadlock last for months? Experts analyse the obstacles blocking a lasting deal.

item.title: DR Congo Ebola health workers protest unpaid wages as deaths surpass 1,800
item.description: Aid workers say the virus is spreading at an 'alarming and unprecedented rate' as virus spreads to remote areas.

item.title: DR Congo river boat under quarantine for Ebola after five deaths
item.description: The health minister says all the passengers are being screened as a precautionary measure.

item.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages
item.description: Neither the US or Oman have commented on the proposed agreement on the vital waterway.
